📚 Village knowledge: Alejandro taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Alejandro showed Catalina the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.

Alejandro is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
